content.short: Python EVM Assembler is a library for assembling and disassembling the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) code.
content.description: Python EVM Assembler (pyevmasm) is a library that provides both an assembler and a disassembler for the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Developers can use its Python API and command-line interface to inspect deployed smart contracts by disassembling their bytecode and to reconstruct the original assembly by assembling it again. The project is open-source and welcomes contributions and security-focused analysis from the broader developer community, supporting both analysis and recreation workflows for contract verification.
